transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I… I came in because most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. Like the old Ruben—the one who could talk to anybody and actually enjoy the day—is just… gone.
How long have you been experiencing this heavy, hollow feeling?
About eight months now, I guess. It started around when the new regional manager came in and started… taking accounts from me, ones I’d had for years.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy before this heavy, hollow feeling started?

Not really. I used to like bowling, messing around in the garden, taking my wife to little gallery shows… dancing sometimes. Now I just kind of sit there and come up with reasons not to go. It all feels like too much effort.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight since this heavy, hollow feeling started?
I… don’t really know. I haven’t been keeping track of my weight, so I can’t say if it’s changed much.
Have you ever thought about harming yourself since this heavy, hollow feeling started?
I… yeah. I don’t like saying it, but I’ve had thoughts like maybe my wife and kids would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. It scares me. I don’t feel like I can trust myself the way I used to.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?
No… not really. Those were the things I used to look forward to — bowling, the garden, taking my wife to shows, dancing. Now I just… make excuses not to go. None of it feels worth the effort.
Do you still enjoy spending time with your wife and kids, or has that become less enjoyable as well?

It’s… less enjoyable, yeah. I love them, I do, but even being with my wife and kids feels like something I’m just sitting through sometimes. I make excuses, or I’m there but not really… there. Nothing feels worth the effort like it used to.
Have you experienced periods of feeling this low before the current episode started eight months ago?
I don’t know… not like this, I don’t think. I’ve had rough stretches before, sure, but this feels different. Eight months is… a long time.
Do you feel like you've withdrawn from your friends or social connections since this heavy feeling started?

Yeah… I guess I have. I don’t really go out much anymore. I used to look forward to bowling, or working in the garden, taking my wife to gallery shows, dancing… now I just sit there or make excuses not to go. It all feels like too much effort.
Have you ever felt this low before in your life, prior to the past eight months?
I… I’m not really sure. I’ve had bad times before, like anyone, but I don’t know that it was ever like this. Hard to compare, I guess.
Have you ever been diagnosed with depression before this episode started eight months ago?
No… I don’t think so. Not formally, anyway. I haven’t really talked to anyone about it before this.
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt significantly depressed before the past eight months?
I don’t really know. I’ve had rough stretches, sure, but… nothing I can clearly point to and say it was like this.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt depressed like this before the past eight months?
I’m not sure I can say that. I’ve had low points, but more than one time like this… I don’t really know.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt as depressed as you do now before the past eight months?
Not before this, no… not like now. Most mornings now I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling, like I’m not really myself anymore. I don’t remember having that before these past months.
Have you had any other periods in your life where you felt as depressed as you do now, before the past eight months?
No… not really. This has been about eight months now, since that new regional manager started leaning on me and taking accounts I’d had for years. Before that, I don’t think it was ever like this.
Have you had any episodes of depression that lasted for two weeks or more before the past eight months?
I don’t think so. I mean, I had bad stretches like anyone, but nothing I’d call an episode like this for two weeks or more.
Have you had an episode of depression like this before that lasted for two weeks or more and then got better before this one started?
No… I don’t think so. Not one that lasted like that and then lifted before this started.
Did you ever feel like you were back to your normal self after a period of feeling really down before this episode started?
I don’t think so… not in that way. I can’t really point to some period where I was down and then felt normal again before this started.
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt depressed for more than two weeks that went away on their own before this episode started?
Not that I remember, no. I’ve had rough times, but I can’t think of one that lasted like that and then just went away before this.
Have you had more than one episode of depression in your lifetime?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had bad stretches, but not more than one separate episode like that… not that I can really say.
